dedupe_keys.name: usgs estimated monthly irrigation water use by huc12 for the conterminous united states iwuedd 2015

description: This USGS data release gives monthly irrigation withdrawals and consumptive use for every 12-digit hydrologic unit (HUC12) in the conterminous United States for 2015. The Irrigation Water Use Estimation Disaggregation and Downscaling Model (IWUEDD) splits the annual county irrigation data of the National Water Use Science Project into months and subwatersheds using county actual evapotranspiration, field-level irrigated lands and other public data, and reports groundwater, surface water, combined withdrawals and consumptive use separately. The outputs are CSV files on ScienceBase with the Python and ArcGIS scripts needed to reproduce them, published in September 2021 and free to download. Caveats: coverage is a single year, values are downscaled estimates, not metered use, and some counties are excluded. Simulation uses: monthly irrigation demand by subwatershed for irrigation capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related records: the USGS public supply water use reanalysis (data-usgs-public-supply-water-use-reanalysis-huc12) and the USGS water data APIs (data-usgs-water-data-apis).
